summaryZh: 官方目录中的 High-Energy Astrophysics Laboratory 从事 X 射线与伽马射线天文仪器研究，开展探测器测试和仪器开发。目录列出 COSI、GAP、NuStar 相关项目，但未注明研究内容的更新时间。
topics: X射线与伽马射线观测技术

evidence.quote: Steven E. Boggs Astronomy & Astrophysics UC San Diego High Energy Astrophysics

Our research is focused on developing and flying new gamma-ray telescopes to probe these energetic astrophysical environments from space. One of our primary interests is the detailed measurement of radioactive nuclei produced in the inner regions of supernova explosions.
High-Energy Astrophysics Laboratory UC San Diego has a long-history of designing X-ray satellites and Gamma-ray instrumentation.
with detector testing and instrument development.
Gamma-ray programs are active in Compton Spectrometer and Imager (COSI) , GAP experiment, and NuStar.
